values.note: City of North Adams: water and electric $30 a night, lakeside (water and electric) $40, full hookup $35; tents $25. Extra overnight visitor $10. No resident/non-resident split. Cash, check, Mastercard or Discover only; one night's deposit to book.

note: City of North Adams municipal campground on Windsor Lake, 1.5 miles from downtown; lakeside, wilderness and pull-through sites, seasonal campers also taken. The city warns to come in via Kemp Avenue and avoid GPS routes by Bradley Street. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the city's campground pages: 100 sites, water + 20/30A electric with some full-hookup sites, pull-throughs, dump; rates unchanged ($30 W/E, $35 FHU, $40 lakeside, $25 tent; no resident discount); reservations by phone/email with a one-night deposit (platform phone - the camping.northadams-ma.gov reservation site no longer resolves). Note cleaned of field facts. Season and max_rig_ft left as stored; the city pages state neither. Gate n/a (local); $40 top rate is under $50 anyway.
